root_cause: Release 3.14.0 changed the session cache from a bounded LRU with a 15-minute TTL to an unbounded HashMap keyed by token, so session entries are never evicted and heap grows until the container hits its memory limit and is OOMKilled.
trigger_text: 2026-11-01T10:07:28.000 INFO  [session-cache] deploy applied: session-cache backend switched to UnboundedMap (eviction_policy=none, max_entries=unlimited) in release 3.14.0
